calls.statement:
WITH h AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15),
e AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure x JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=x.member_key WHERE x.campaign_id=15),
s AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM stg_campaign_contact_load x JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=x.member_key WHERE x.campaign_id=15)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM h) holdout_distinct,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM e) contacted_distinct,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h JOIN e USING(member_id)) overlap,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member)) holdout_unknown,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=15) exposure_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM s) stg_contacted,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h JOIN s USING(member_id)) stg_overlap

calls.statement:
SELECT count(DISTINCT h.member_id) AS holdout_members,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.marketing_consent THEN h.member_id END) AS consent_at_start,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT m2.member_id) FROM dim_member m2 WHERE m2.marketing_consent AND DATE '2025-11-24' BETWEEN m2.valid_from AND m2.valid_to AND m2.join_date <= DATE '2025-11-24') AS eligible_consent
FROM campaign_holdout h JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_id=h.member_id AND DATE '2025-11-24' BETWEEN m.valid_from AND m.valid_to
WHERE h.campaign_id=15
